result_text:
`analyzeLandscape` is added as a second name for `updateLandscape`, and the `cli` module tests pass. I did not run the jar, because the sandbox asked for approval to execute it, so the help output and end-to-end landscape creation are unverified.

What changed:

- **`cli/.../Commands.java`**: new `ANALYZE_LANDSCAPE` constant and description ("...The landscape counterpart of the analysis commands; the same as updateLandscape"). It is listed in the no-argument usage overview, using the same landscape options as `updateLandscape`.
- **`cli/.../CommandLineInterface.java`**: `run` dispatches both names to the same `updateLandscape(args)` method, so options and behaviour are identical. For `-help`, the usage prefix is `args[0]`, so the command the user typed is shown, and the matching description is chosen. `updateLandscape -help` still prints its own usage.
- **`README.md`**: the README had no command list, so I added a short "Landscape report" section covering both names and the shared options. Say if you wanted this somewhere else.

`CLAUDE.md` still lists only `updateLandscape` among the main commands; I left it alone since you asked only for the README.
